message.content:
Card AB#2 "The cart total ignores quantity". Repo root is the card branch `card/2-the-cart-total-ignores-quantity`; work in your own worktree off it.

Bug: `api/src/cart.ts` `cartTotal` reduces with `sum + line.price`, ignoring `line.quantity`. Fix: `sum + line.price * line.quantity` (VAT still applied once to the subtotal afterward, then Math.round, unchanged).

The failing test already exists: `api/test/cart.test.ts` "cart total counts each line's quantity" (expects 1125, gets 375). Don't change tests. From `api/`, run `npm test` and confirm all pass (2 pass + this one; one test.skip stays skipped).

Commit with subject exactly: `NO-TASK Count each cart line's quantity in the total.` (one line, no trailers).

Return: your branch name, worktree path, commit sha, and the test pass/fail counts. Short result only.

<system-reminder>
Your final report is delivered through SubagentHandback: when your work is complete, call SubagentHandback({message: <your full report>}). The call ends your run, so make it your last step. Only a SubagentHandback call reaches your caller as your result; plain text you write at the end is not delivered. Do not also send the report with SendMessage: your caller would get it twice.
</system-reminder>

input.command: git rev-parse --show-toplevel && git branch --show-current && grep -n "line.price" api/src/cart.ts
